LESSON: CHURCH SERVICE WORSHIP

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PLACES OF
Topic 5.2: Church Service WORSHIP

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Church Service WORSHIP. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different activities that take place during the church service for harmonious living
2. demonstrate the activities that are performed during the church service for interpersonal interaction
3. sing songs that relate to the activities that take place during the church service for spiritual growth
4. desire to participate in the activities that are done during the church service for self fulfilment e) appreciate the activities that take place during church service for spiritual nourishment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different activities that take place during the church service for harmonious living
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different activities that take place during the church service for harmonious living. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate the activities that are performed during the church service for interpersonal interaction
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate the activities that are performed during the church service for interpersonal interaction. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. sing songs that relate to the activities that take place during the church service for spiritual growth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing songs that relate to the activities that take place during the church service for spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. desire to participate in the activities that are done during the church service for self fulfilment e) appreciate the activities that take place during church service for spiritual nourishment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to participate in the activities that are done during the church service for self fulfilment e) appreciate the activities that take place during church service for spiritual nourishment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Church Service WORSHIP.
2. Explain Church Service WORSHIP to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Church Service WORSHIP. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Church Service WORSHIP important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
